title: Into the Wild
author: Jon Krakauer
summary: Jon Krakauer reconstructs the life of Chris McCandless, a young man who gave away his savings, headed into the Alaskan wilderness in 1992 and was found dead months later. He also draws on his own youth.
readIf: you are curious about what drives people to risk everything in the wild.
skipIf: you want a tidy verdict, since the book leaves open why McCandless died and who he was.
